Dialogs.Dialog: Of course I do. What is it？
Hehe. Did you want to talk to me？
Hello, it's ●. Is now a good time？
I'm glad you called. What's up？
Hello, it's ●. Can you talk right now？
It's ●. Is now a good time？
Want to stop by ▲デート場所▲ on the way home today？
Okay. I'm looking forward to it.
Hmm, I don't think I can...
That's not really a good time for me...
I can't today... So ask me again another day.
Want to skip class and just go right now？ Hehe.
We can't do that. Besides, it's better to save the fun for later.
I really like stopping places on the way home from school.
You stood me up last time, you know. How should I have you make it up to me？
I'm really sorry. It'll be fine this time! I'll make sure you have fun.
You'd better make up for standing me up last time.
Don't stand me up again, okay？ I'm really looking forward to it.
I'm sorry. I'll make sure our next date is great to make it up to you.
About you leaving me hanging the other day... I guess I'll forgive you.
Sorry about that. I didn't do it on purpose, though...
Oh well. With this, I'll call us even for you ignoring me before.
With this, I'll forgive you for neglecting me the other day, too. Oh well.
Thanks. I really did learn my lesson.
You haven't come to see me at all lately... I was actually pretty worried.
We haven't seen each other at all lately. Any longer and I would've forgotten all about you, you know!
Sorry, sorry. Don't forget about me, okay？
What a relief. Since you wouldn't see me at all, I wondered if I'd... done something wrong.
Hey, there's ▲生成選択肢１▲ coming up. Want to go ▲月▲ ▲日▲, ▲デート場所▲？
Nice. I've been wanting to go to that.
Sounds good. I'm actually interested in that.
Did you know I wanted to go to that？ Hehe.
Huh, didn't know they had something like that. Sure, why not.
Okay, sure. I'm curious to see what it's like.
Yeah, that works. I wonder what it'll be like.
Hmm, doesn't look like I can make it. Too bad, though.
I'm not really in the mood... so I'll pass.
Sorry... Invite me again if something else comes up.
I can't make it that day. Can we do another day？
Man, I don't know why, but I'm already starting to get excited.
Haha, getting a little ahead of yourself, aren't you？
Well, I guess that settles it, then？
I probably won't care about class at all that day. I'm blaming you for that.
●？ Well, I'm glad you're looking forward to it, anyway.
Right after school, huh. That could be nice, too.
Anyway, I'm looking forward to it. Maybe I'll read up on it a little.
I think I really can't wait. Make sure you live up to my expectations.
Thanks for giving me something else to look forward to.
Hello？ It's Rinko. Is now a good time to talk？
Hey, on the way home today... want to go somewhere together？
Hey, let's stop somewhere on the way home today.
Um, want to stop somewhere together on the way home today？
See you later, then. I'll be waiting by the school gate.
Got it. See you later, then.
All right, let's meet by the school gate after school.
Got it. See you after school.
Great! I'll be waiting at the school gate after school, then. Hehe.
...Sorry. Let's call it off this time after all.
Hmm... okay. Maybe next time, then.
Sorry! Let's cancel this time after all.
Okay. It's set for that day, then.
That day doesn't really work for me...
Even though we just saw each other？ Well... I wouldn't mind.
You want to see me that badly？ Hehe... sure.
You want to meet up again？ I don't mind.
Didn't we just see each other？ Oh, all right.
We just saw each other a little while ago. Still, okay.
All right, meet me at ▲デート場所▲ now.
We haven't seen each other lately, so I was getting a little worried. Thanks for asking me out. See you soon.
See you at ▲デート場所▲, then.
Hasn't it been a while since you asked to meet up？ I guess I'll hurry over for you... Hehe.
All right, see you at ▲デート場所▲.
Got it. It's been a while since we did this... I'm happy. I can't wait to see you, so I'll hurry over.
Sorry... I just really wanted to see you.
Listen. I'm telling you I don't want to see you.
...Still, I really want to see you.
Look... I told you I don't want to.
Sorry. I know, I just really want to see you.
I didn't say I'd come, okay？ Bye.
...Waiting might be a waste of time, you know.
I'll still wait for you. See you.
Hello... It's Rinko. I want to see you right now...
Hey, it's Rinko. I want to see you right now... Just say yes.
Um, it's Rinko. So, um... I was hoping to see you right now. ...Can we？
I'll be waiting. Come right away, okay？ Promise？
Then let's meet at ▲デート場所▲.
Works for me. Hurry over, okay？ I'll seriously be mad if you're late.
Okay, let's meet at ▲デート場所▲ then.
Yay. Sorry for being so selfish, okay？ ...Hehe.
It's fine, ● want to see you too.
Okay, let's meet at ▲時▲ at ▲デート場所▲.
Got it, I'll be waiting... Though I really wanted to see you right now.
Sorry. ● won't keep you waiting. See you later.
Alright. Let's meet at ▲時▲ at ▲デート場所▲, then.
You better show up. If you're even a little late, I'll kick you.
Haha. Don't worry, I'll be there. See you.
Alright, it's settled. Let's meet at ▲時▲ at ▲デート場所▲.
Okay, I'm glad. Thanks for letting me be a little selfish.
I don't think you're being selfish at all. See you later.
Sorry... I just can't right now.
I really can't make it... Sorry.
Come on, I really want to see you!
I just can't make it... Sorry.
No! I want to see you. Is there really... no way at all？
I really can't make it after all... I'm sorry.
I see... Guess it can't be helped, since it's so sudden. It's fine... Don't worry.
I'm really sorry... Especially since you asked me out.
Ugh, there's just no way I can make it...
Oh, really. Even after I begged you this much？ ...Whatever. Idiot!
I'm really sorry. Let's make it another time.
Sorry... There's just no way I can make it work.
I see... Okay. Sorry for being so selfish. I'll... hold back this time.
I'm really sorry. Thanks for asking me out, though. Let's meet up another time.
Listen... I figured I should probably thank you.
You know, for asking me out on a date.
We're dating, aren't we？ That's only natural.
Still, it's a little different from a regular date. So... yeah.
I see. Well, if you're happy, then ● am too.
Um, I just thought I'd say thank you. Just because.
You asked me out on a date, didn't you？
Even so, it felt special compared to usual. ...It made me happy.
Hearing you say that, ● am happy too.
You asked me out on a date, right？ So, thank you.
It's totally normal for a guy to ask his girlfriend out.
Still, this next date feels special to me, not just like any other date... So I'm happy.
Thanks. ● feel the same way, so thank you too.
Hey, how many hours left until our date？
Well, I guess it doesn't really matter.
Because... even if I know how many hours are left, it won't stop my heart from racing.
Talking like this is really getting my hopes up.
(Looks like I've gotta make sure she has a good time no matter what.)
I'm really looking forward to our next date.
Well, it is a little special.
Yeah. Though for me, anywhere is special as long as I'm with you.
...You're being unusually honest. You're gonna make me blush.
Hey, can you tell how much I can't wait for our date？
When you say it that clearly, yeah, I can tell.
Really？ Then can you tell how much I'm looking forward to it？
Is there a difference between not being able to wait and looking forward to it？
It's, like, a difference in nuance. Kind of.
I've gotta make sure I'm in top shape by our date.
Haha, aren't you exaggerating a little？
I'm not exaggerating. Make sure you're in top shape too.
What am I supposed to do？
Stuff like washing your hands and gargling when you get home so you don't catch a cold, eating nutritious food, going to bed early...
(So basically, just taking care of my health...)
In that case, ● would have to agree.
Not being able to wait like this is what makes the actual date even more exciting, though.
I heard it's supposed to be cloudy on the day of our date.
Well, that's fine in its own way. Might make it nice and comfortable out.
Hmm, I guess so. Well, if you're fine with it.
I checked the weather forecast, and it says it's gonna rain on the day of our date.
I hate when it rains, 'cause it makes my mood feel all gloomy too.
Maybe the rain clouds won't stand a chance against the energy you and ● have, and they'll just blow away! Haha!
...Are you being serious？ That's so corny.
Did you get ready for tomorrow yet？
Not yet, I'm about to. Are you all ready, ▲小早川＊▲？
No, not yet. What should I even get ready？
Your clothes for tomorrow, what you're bringing... stuff like that, I guess.
You can bring some if you want, but... it makes it sound like a field trip. Haha.
What time are you getting up tomorrow？
Not sure, I haven't decided yet.
Then I'll decide for you. Wake up at 5:30 in the morning!
...That's way too early. Besides, our date's in the evening, isn't it？
Too bad! You've gotta put some spirit into this kind of thing.
(Spirit, huh？ Guess that means she's looking forward to it.)
Hey, it really is tomorrow, right？ Our date.
I've been waiting for it to get here for so long... Now that it's finally tomorrow, I can hardly believe it.
Then what are you gonna think once tomorrow gets here？
I might think, 'Is it really today？'
Haha. Don't worry, it's definitely tomorrow. Make sure you show up.
You know what tomorrow is, right？
Of course I do. Our date, right？
I'll be mad if you're late tomorrow, okay？ And standing me up is completely out of the question.
I'll be fine. Don't threaten me before we even go.
I'm really looking forward to our date tomorrow. Hehe.
You remember our plans for today, right？
I'm gonna have as much fun as I can today.
I've been excited all morning. What about you？
Maybe we should've scheduled our next date a little sooner.
I wish the day of our date would hurry up and get here. Having to wait is stressing me out.
(● just hope she doesn't take that stress out on me.)
I was thinking about our next date, and I just wanted to hear your voice.
Oh yeah？ Then we can talk as long as you want.
Hello... What time is it right now？
Sorry! I'm almost there, so wait for me.
I'll give you five more minutes.
Hello, it's Rinko. Do you know what I'm calling to say？
Really？ You had me worried... I'll be waiting, so hurry up and get here.
Yeah, I'm really sorry. I'll be right there!
I'm sorry... I don't even have an excuse.
So, what are you going to do？
I'll make it up to you next time.
Hey, what's the big idea？ You think you can make me wait this long and get away with it？
Well then, what do you want to do now？
I'll make it up to you another time.
Listen... I was waiting for you the whole time, you know？
What are we doing now？ Should I wait, or do this another time？
Let me make it up to you next time.
Would it be okay if I came over now？
Okay... Then I'll head back to our meeting spot, too.
Thanks. I'll definitely be there this time.
Will you still go on our date if I come now？
Guess I have no choice... Then get to the meeting spot right now! Got it？
I'll head over now. Is that okay？
Okay. Then I'll wait for you at the meeting spot again.
I'm really sorry. I'll be right there.
I'll definitely make it up to you next time...
You'd better... It's a promise, okay？
I promise I'll make this up to you next time. Sorry about today!
Oh, really... Fine. Don't forget you said that, okay？
...Will you let me make it up to you next time？
Okay. It's a shame, but next time, then... I'll be counting on it.
Hey, why didn't you show up today？ Did you forget our promise？
Shouldn't "I'm sorry" come before the excuses？ Come on, say it.
Sigh... Fine, I'll let it slide this time.
Thanks. I'll be more careful next time.
I couldn't quite hear you. Did you say "I'm sorry"？
Standing me up on a date... I really can't believe you.
I'm sorry... I didn't do it on purpose.
I see. Still, it makes me worry, you know...
Hey... Did I do something wrong？
Because of how you've been acting lately. ...It makes me uneasy, you know.
I see... I'll make sure to keep in touch more.
If you do that, I might not feel so uneasy...
I see... Well then, want to meet up right now？
Yeah. I'll be waiting at ▲デート場所▲.
You're just overthinking it. It's all in your head.
You think so？ ...I hope you're right.
● will try to be a little more careful too.
How are you feeling？ Is it really bad？
I'm okay. I just need to rest for a bit and I'll be fine.
You better make sure you stay in bed. I'll try to come visit you, too.
Yeah, thanks for worrying about me.
Hey... Are you okay？ I got a little worried, so I called to check on you.
Don't push yourself. Just take it easy and get plenty of rest, okay？
Thanks. I'm feeling a little better already.
Our date was fun, wasn't it？
Let's go out again sometime. Okay？
Of course. I might ask you out even if you say no.
How was the date？ Tell me what you thought.
Tell me what you thought first, ▲小早川＊▲.
For me... it wasn't bad. Actually, not bad at all.
So that means you liked it. ● did too.
That date was fun. I'd like to go again.
Haha. Getting a little ahead of yourself, aren't you？
You know, I feel really happy right now.
● felt the same way. It's all thanks to you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Right back at you. Anyway, it's because the date was so great.
Yeah. We really had a great time.
My heart's been racing ever since I got home.
● feel the same way. That date really was the best.
Really, it made me feel so happy. Thanks.
Let's make the next date even better.
Try and guess how I'm feeling right now.
Wrong! The right answer is: super happy. Thanks for the best date.
Hey, thanks for getting everything ready for our date.
You're welcome. I'm just glad you enjoyed it.
If every day were like this, that'd be amazing.
Haha. This kind of thing is special because it's only once in a while.
I know that. I just meant that's how much fun I had!
▲小早川＊▲... ● should be the one thanking you.
Hey, I just wanted to say thanks.
Yeah. Because our date was extra fun.
Then ● have to thank you too, ▲小早川＊▲.
No way! I'm saying it first. Thanks for such a special time... Hehe.
(Man... That makes me blush a little.)
Wasn't it a lot of work getting everything ready for this date？
Hmm, well, it wasn't that big a deal.
Listen to you trying to act cool...
I just mean it's no big deal if I'm doing it for my girlfriend.
Hehe... That makes me kinda happy. Thanks to you, we made some really special memories. Thanks.
Yeah. Let's go make more special memories sometime.
You know, I think I actually really like having dates at your place.
Then make sure you clean every day so I can come over whenever.
There's something really relaxing about your room, you know.
Really？ Then you can stay forever. Just kidding!
Dummy. You know I can't do that...
I had fun at your place. Hey, can I come over again sometime？
Of course. Come over as much as you want!
...When you say it like that, it's a little much.
So, care to tell me what you thought of my place？
I made myself right at home. Thanks.
Good. Then come over again sometime.
I feel like there's still a trace of you lingering in my room.
More like your presence, or your vibe... Anyway, it feels nice!
It feels nice, huh... Good to know.
Did you have fun at my place？
Yeah, I had a great time. Can I come over again？
Of course. Anytime! ...Well, maybe not anytime, but for the most part, you're welcome to.
Hey, thanks for letting me use your bath.
Sure. I didn't mind at all.
It kind of got my heart racing a little.
The food we had on our date was really good.
Yeah, I'll keep that in mind.
I really liked the food at that place we went to on our date.
Oh yeah？ Glad you liked it.
Where you eat on a date might actually be pretty important.
True. I'll make sure to choose carefully from now on, too.
I might have to give you a little more credit.
Because the place you picked for us to eat on our date suited my tastes perfectly.
I see. Guess I picked a winner, then.
Hey, what are you doing right now？
Just spacing out for now, I guess.
Is spacing out really something you do 'for now'？
Now that you mention it, that does sound weird.
I didn't really call for any reason in particular. I just wondered what you were up to.
What are you up to, ▲小早川＊▲？
I knew you were going to say that...
Hey, what were you up to just now？
Uh... What was I doing again？
Wow, going senile already？ Get well soon.
Hey... I suddenly felt like hearing your voice.
Really？ ● was hoping to hear your voice too, ▲小早川＊▲.
Got any interesting stories for me？
Well, that's sudden. ...I can't just come up with something on the spot.
Eh, whatever. Really, I just wanted to hear your voice for a bit.
Oh, is that it？ Still, maybe I'll have a story ready for next time.
What's wrong？ Did ● say something weird？
Nope. I'm just happy I got to hear your voice.
Sorry for calling so late. Were you still up？
I called because I couldn't sleep. But now that I'm hearing your voice, I feel like I might be able to.
So ● work as a lullaby now, huh？ Haha.
I couldn't sleep for some reason, so I ended up calling. ...Is it okay to talk？
Sure, as long as you want.
Thanks. Your voice really calms me down. Wonder why？
Maybe we're just on the same wavelength？
I'll probably stay up a little longer. What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
I'm still up, too... I closed my eyes to go to sleep and you popped into my head, so I called.
Just thought I'd say good night before going to bed.
You called just for that？ Thanks.
You gotta say good night before going to bed, right？
Good night. Make sure you dream about me.
Haha, no pressure or anything. Good night.
Hey, I just felt like saying good night.
Hey! I wanted to say it first. Um, good night. Sweet dreams... hehe.
I think I have committee duty tomorrow. What a pain.
Come on, don't be like that.
Just thinking about the work is making me tired and sleepy. ...Good night.
Yeah, good night. Hang in there tomorrow.
Man, I'm beat. I bet I'll sleep like a log tonight.
Did something happen to tire you out that much？
Just a bunch of stuff. I'm a busy girl, you know. Anyway, good night.
Yeah, good night. ● should get to bed soon, too.
I'm not all that tired. I'm still young, after all. Still, I'm gonna turn in early. Good night.
I'm only a year older than you, though. Oh well. Good night.
I'm fine. Hearing your voice woke me right up.
Listen to how sleepy you sound. Come on, snap out of it.
Mmm... All right! Time to power through and get up.
Morning. You know it's morning already, right？
Yeah... Is it this late already？
How do you like my wake-up call？ Happy to hear from me？
Yeah. I feel like today's gonna be a good day.
It's morning already, so get up, okay？
Yeah, right. You still sound fast asleep. Don't just go back to bed after we hang up.
Got it. I'll get up for real.
Not quite... I was still half-asleep.
Come on, up you get. They say waking up early earns you three mon. Quick, how much is three mon today？
Ugh... Don't quiz me first thing in the morning.
This is Rinko with your morning announcement.
Come on, wake up for real. You're not allowed to oversleep after getting a wake-up call from me.
You're right. Thanks for waking me up.
Haven't you been slacking off on committee duty lately？ Make sure you show up.
Have I...？ When am ● on duty next？
*Sigh*... I knew it. Just make sure you come, okay？ I'm there too, after all.
Yeah, got it. I'll be more careful.
I'm hanging up now, okay？ Bye.
Look at the time. I should probably hang up now.
I'd like to talk a little longer, but... it's getting late. Anyway, see you later. Bye.
I want to keep talking, but I really should hang up. Let's pick this up next time we meet, okay？ Bye.
What？ I'm mad at you right now, you know.
Aren't we both guilty of that, though？
Of course—● was the one in the wrong. I'm sorry.
...That makes me feel stupid for being mad all by myself.
...Fine, I guess. Next time I see you, though... Well, whatever. I forgive you.
(Looks like she's in a better mood now...)
● think we're both in the wrong here.
Then let's just make up already.
What's with that...? Quit acting so grown-up.
Well, ● happen to be more grown-up than you.
Shut up, old man. ...Fine, whatever. We're good now.
(Looks like she's in a better mood now...)
Thinking it over, ● wasn't in the wrong here, right？
So you're saying it's my fault, then？
Not saying that, but... ● shouldn't take all the blame, either.
...Well, I guess I might've been a little selfish too.
There's no point staying mad at each other, so let's make up. Okay？
(Looks like she's in a better mood now...)
...A missed call from ▲小早川＊▲. Looks like she left a message.
Hello, it's Rinko. Um, today's your birthday, right？
Anyway, happy birthday. I really wanted to tell you directly, though.
(She remembered, and I missed her call. Now I feel bad...)
It's Rinko. Today's an important anniversary for us, isn't it？
That's why I called, but... well, I guess it can't be helped.
(Right, so that's why she called me...)
Looks like you're not picking up, so I'm leaving a message. Bye.
(She called just for that. I wish I could've heard it from her directly.)
Hello, it's Rinko. ...I was hoping I could see you. ...I'll call again later.
(Shoot... I missed my chance to hang out with her.)
It's Rinko. I called 'cause I wanted to see you, so why did I get your voicemail？
(...Maybe I should call her back and ask her to hang out？)
Um, I kind of wanted to see you... If you're busy, another time's fine. Bye.
(Maybe ● should give her a call later.)
...It's Rinko. I wanted to talk about our next date, but... well, never mind.
(I should probably call her back later.)
I was gonna ask you out on a date, and you didn't even pick up...
It's Rinko. I called to ask if you wanted to go on a date... Maybe next time.
(She went out of her way to call. I feel bad for missing it.)
Hello, it's Rinko. Um... No real reason, I just felt like calling. Bye.
(I wonder what's up？ I'll get back to her later.)
